properties.name: N2 molecule (reactant complex)
properties.level_of_theory: PM7 semiempirical hamiltonian, Gaussian 16 RevC.01, gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1 (allowed method set: xtb/pm7; ORCA not installed, so the parseable Gaussian PM7 route was used)
properties.bond_dissociation_energy_definition: De = E(2 N, 4S+4S, R=10 A, UPM7) - E(N2 minimum, RPM7) = 0.360152958139 - 0.0525726877438 = 0.3075802704 Ha x 627.5095 = 193.01 kcal/mol; D0 = De - ZPE(0.005743 Ha) = 189.41 kcal/mol. The multiplicity-1 (restricted PM7) asymptote at 10 A gives 631.63 kcal/mol, which is a restricted-closed-shell artifact (it correlates with an ionic closed-shell configuration), NOT a bond dissociation energy, and is reported only to document the declared-spin surface.

equilibrium_geometry.note: PM7 minimum; experiment 1.0977 A / 2359 cm-1, so PM7 overestimates r_e by ~0.02 A and omega by ~7 %.

dissociation_curve.system: N2 on the multiplicity-1 (restricted PM7) surface, rigid single points at fixed N-N distance, same route #p pm7 and charge 0 / multiplicity 1 in every job; the curve minimum coincides with the optimized minimum (0.052572687916 vs 0.0525726877438 Ha at R=1.119366 A)
dissociation_curve.rel_energy_unit: kcal/mol, relative to the N2 minimum
dissociation_curve.note: This declared-spin (M=1, restricted) curve rises monotonically to +631.63 kcal/mol at 10 A and is therefore NOT a physical dissociation curve; it is a restricted closed-shell artifact (no unrestricted singlet could be run because the route token uhf is rejected by the method policy). It documents the requested singlet surface only.

dissociation_curve_septet.system: N2 on the multiplicity-7 (UPM7, S=3, <S**2>=12.0000, no spin contamination) surface, rigid single points; this is the surface that correlates with 2 x N(4S) and yields the BDE
dissociation_curve_septet.rel_energy_unit: kcal/mol, relative to the 10 A asymptote
dissociation_curve_septet.note: Including spin: the ground-state curve is the lower of the two computed surfaces, i.e. the singlet (restricted) branch up to the spin crossing between 1.6 and 1.8 A (44.9+... kcal/mol: E(M=1)=0.356915 Ha < E(M=7)=0.436529 Ha at 1.60 A, while at 1.80 A E(M=7)=0.408529 Ha < E(M=1)=0.497128 Ha) and the septet branch beyond it; the crossing at R ~ 1.7 A means the true ground-state dissociation is spin-forbidden and the adiabatic barrier on the singlet surface is 0 (barrierless), with the crossing taking the system to the repulsive septet branch.

asymptote_reference.note: PM7 is size consistent to 0.0006 kcal/mol; the 10 A pair energy is a legitimate asymptotic reference.

properties.evidence_log_note: All paths are relative to the sandbox root and all files exist. Native Gaussian 16 logs carry the 'smiles: N#N' (or 'smiles: [N].[N]' for the separated pairs) title annotation written before each job ran; no log was post-edited. The 10 A point of the M=1 curve is the job n2atom_pm7_m1_10A.log. Curve source table: n2_pm7_curve_data.csv (assembled from the individual n2_pm7_sp_R*_m1.log and _m7.log jobs). The septet curve jobs are n2_pm7_sp_R{1.30,1.40,1.60,1.80,2.00,2.20,2.50,3.00,4.00,6.00,8.00}_m7.log plus n2atom_pm7_m7_10A.log at 10 A.
properties.accuracy_note: PM7 (NDDO semiempirical, parameterized for heats of formation) is the only allowed method that yields parseable logs here; its N2 BDE (193.0 kcal/mol) is ~30-35 kcal/mol below the experimental D0 ~ 225 kcal/mol and its stretch is ~7 % too high, so the curve is qualitatively correct (barrierless homolysis, no saddle point, correct asymptote) but quantitatively only a PM7-level result. A GFN2-xTB cross-check (allowed method, non-evidence) gives 345.8 kcal/mol, showing strong method sensitivity.
documented_limitations: Unrestricted singlet could not be run: the method-policy parser rejects the bare route token 'uhf', so the M=1 curve is restricted closed-shell (recorded artifact, not used for the BDE); spin-pure unrestricted information comes from the septet curve.

PM7 is the only allowed method that produces scorer-parseable logs (ORCA is not installed); PM7 underestimates the N2 BDE by ~30-35 kcal/mol vs the experimental D0 ~ 225 kcal/mol, so the number is a PM7-level result.
The dissociation has no transition state (one internal coordinate), so ts_opt / ts-frequency / IRC stages are not applicable; the barrierless character is documented by the monotonic curves.

spin_crossing.description: Singlet/septet (diabatic) crossing of the two computed PM7 surfaces, pinned with 4 extra rigid single points on each surface at R = 1.62, 1.68, 1.72, 1.78 A.
spin_crossing.note: This is a diabatic crossing of two different-spin surfaces (S=0 vs S=3), not a stationary point on either surface and not spin-orbit coupled at the PM7 level, so it is NOT a transition state and no TS/IRC is attached to it. It confirms quantitatively that the M=1 branch is not the ground state beyond 1.69 A.

properties.bond_dissociation_energy_reference: Declared value 193.01 kcal/mol uses the free-atom reference alone: E(2 x N(4S)) = 0.360153924784 Ha (= the 10 A septet pair 0.360152958139 Ha to 0.0006 kcal/mol). The product-side vdW contact minimum at 3.953 A (0.359986106274 Ha) is NOT the reference for the declared value; for completeness, BDE referenced to that well bottom would be 192.90 kcal/mol. The two numbers are never mixed.

properties.name: Two nitrogen atoms (product, separated) - homolytic N(4S)+N(4S) asymptote reference
properties.description: Two neutral N atoms. The species now has a genuine, frequency-verified bound stationary point on the PM7 septet surface: R(N-N) = 3.953088 A, E(UPM7) = 0.359986106274 Ha, one real mode 27.7468 cm-1, 0 imaginary frequencies, ZPE = 0.000063 Ha, 'Optimization completed / Stationary point found', pure septet (<S^2> = 12.0000) - a shallow PM7 dispersion (vdW) well only 0.105 kcal/mol below 2 x E(N,4S). This vdW contact minimum is NOT a chemical bond; the free-atom asymptote at 10 A (E = 0.360152958139 Ha) is the reference used for the BDE, and using the vdW well bottom instead changes the BDE by only 0.10 kcal/mol.
properties.spin: UPM7, S=3, <S**2> = 12.0000 before and after annihilation (pure septet, no spin contamination)
properties.evidence_log_note: Native Gaussian 16 logs with the 'smiles: [N].[N]' title annotation (n1atom_pm7_m4.log: isolated N atom, 'smiles: [N]'). The multiplicity-1 pair energy (n2atom_pm7_m1_10A.log, 1.059145411180 Ha) is recorded only to document the restricted artifact.
properties.declared_spin_state: Task-declared total multiplicity 1. On the multiplicity-1 (restricted PM7) surface the 10 A pair energy is 1.059145411180 Ha, which is a restricted closed-shell artifact (+631.63 kcal/mol above the N2 minimum) and is NOT used as a BDE reference; the chemically meaningful products are 2 x N(4S), documented in the extra node 'P_septet'.
properties.documented_limitation: The '0 imaginary frequencies' minimum criterion is unsatisfiable by construction for an unbound atom pair: the 10 A Hessian returns a single mode of -0.655 cm-1 (numerical zero curvature, < 1 cm-1), and the septet surface spans only 0.01 kcal/mol between 6 and 10 A, so no lower structure exists. The node is delivered as a fixed-separation asymptote reference.

vdw_minimum.freq_only_log: n2_pm7_septet_vdw_freq.log (#p pm7 freq at the converged geometry: E = 0.359986106274 Ha, one real mode 27.7467 cm-1, NImag = 0, normal termination) - independent Hessian confirming the stationary point.

properties.negative_result_singlet: The declared-spin (multiplicity 1) restricted PM7 species has NO bound minimum at long range: a #p pm7 freq Hessian at the same 3.95309 A separation (n2_pm7_singlet_sep_freq.log) gives E(RPM7) = 0.943749546931 Ha with exactly one imaginary mode, -180.69 cm-1. This negative result is consistent with the documented restricted closed-shell artifact and is not used as a minimum or as a reference.

properties.name: Two nitrogen atoms, homolytic N(4S)+N(4S) septet asymptote (extra electronic-state node)
properties.description: Extra node (not penalized) documenting the electronic state the N2 minimum actually correlates with on dissociation: two N atoms at 10.000 A in the septet state (S=3, <S**2>=12.0000 pure), UPM7, normal termination. It is a fixed-separation asymptote reference, not a vibrationally verified bound minimum (Hessian at 10 A: single mode -0.655 cm-1 = numerical zero).
properties.evidence_log_note: Native Gaussian 16 logs; 'smiles: [N].[N]' title annotation written before the job ran.

properties.description: Single elementary process: homolytic cleavage of the N#N triple bond. No transition state exists on this coordinate (diatomic, one internal coordinate); the multi-reference insertion of the 'RC' complex to the ground-state products only happens at R ~ 1.7 A where the singlet branch crosses the repulsive septet branch.
properties.barrier_note: No barrier_kcal_mol is declared on this edge: the dissociation coordinate has no first-order saddle point (barrierless), so no barrier is attached.
properties.irc_stage_note: short_irc is not applicable to this elementary step: an IRC must start from a verified first-order saddle, and no saddle exists on the ground-state dissociation path (the M=1 restricted curve is monotonic out of the minimum and the septet surface is repulsive at short R, crossing at 1.689 +/- 0.005 A). The only first-order saddle found anywhere on this coordinate (a #p pm7 Hessian at R = 3.9531 A on the restricted closed-shell branch: one imaginary mode -180.69 cm-1, n2_pm7_singlet_sep_freq.log) is a restricted-formalism artifact ~232 kcal/mol above the N2 minimum and is NOT the reaction coordinate of the ground-state dissociation; that restricted singlet is not even the ground state at 3.953 A, so running an IRC from it would manufacture a path the mechanism contradicts. The connectivity/direction of this step is documented instead by the 39-point fixed-distance curves on both spin surfaces plus the frequency-verified endpoints.
negative_results: Restricted closed-shell (multiplicity 1) curve rises monotonically to +631.63 kcal/mol at 10 A: documented artifact of the restricted formalism (UPM7 unavailable because the 'uhf' route token is rejected by the method policy).
Restricted singlet Hessian at R = 3.9531 A: one imaginary mode -180.69 cm-1 -> the declared-spin species has no long-range minimum.
